releaseNotes: check:version-discipline's monotonicity check now counts commits ahead of the merge base through the same skill pathspec the pending-change diff already uses, so a documentation-only branch (README.md, AGENTS.md, and the rest of REPOSITORY_ONLY_PATHS) is no longer forced into a spurious version bump. A nested skill root (skill-root a subdirectory of repo-root) gets the same REPOSITORY_ONLY_PATHS exclusion, closing the same bug on that code path.

Added fixture coverage pinning three outcomes: a repository-only branch passes without a version bump, a branch that actually touches the skill (kernel/) still fails when the version hasn't moved, and a nested skill root's documentation-only branch also passes.
